{{Top|leg}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Although the Force can be used to create terrifying illusions, it is sometimes more satisfying to create actual creatures that are willing and eager to shred and devour one's enemies on command.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="JvS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Sithspawn_JATM.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Sithspawn mutants, originally a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]].]]
'''Sithspawn''' were creatures altered by [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] for use by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Using genetic engineering together with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Sithspawn were remade to be more brutal, more cunning, and, in some cases, more intelligent.

Notable Sithspawn included the [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]],<ref name="darklords4crawl">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]] opening crawl</ref> the mutated [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] caste of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]],<ref name="darklords4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]] monsters and [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydras]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[chrysalide]] [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]],<ref name="deii4">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]],<ref name="JvS" /> the two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Gorc]] and [[Picaroon C. Boodle|Pic]], mutated [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]],<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> [[Smoke Demon]]s,<ref name="Annual">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref> [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]'s [[Monolith]]s,<ref name="Monolith">{{TORcite|type=codex|Monolith}}</ref> and [[Technobeast]]s.<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

The [[darkstaff]], an ancient [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], had the power to turn creatures into Sithspawn, and in about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Len Markus]] used the staff to mutate some [[Mulissiki]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="The Eye">{{LivingForce|EndTimes: The Eye}}</ref>

"Sithspawn" was also used as a swear word.<ref name="XRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> It could also be used as a metaphor for a contemptible person (e.g. "He's the Sithspawn who gave us up to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imps]]")<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> or to emphasize a statement (e.g. "nervous as Sithspawn").<ref name="XRS" />
